item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena dissolves one spoon of salt in a glass of water, and her brother Rohan dissolves three spoons of salt in an identical glass containing the same amount of water. Which statement about their solutions is correct?

options.A: Rohan's solution is more concentrated because it contains more solute in the same amount of water.
options.B: Meena's solution is more concentrated because it contains less solute.
options.C: Both solutions are equally concentrated because both use the same amount of water.
options.D: Neither solution is concentrated because salt always forms dilute solutions in water.
